svg.title: 设创分院帽
svg.desc: 电影海报式手机封面。悬空的描图纸折帽与荧光黄 D 形门，蓝墙上有同济大学校徽与设计创意学院院标。右上角为 12.22 双年晚会。
svg.metadata: {"title": "设创分院帽", "stage": "手机首页视觉审稿", "eventReference": "https://www.figma.com/design/AHxZZSDWKWSkfQtmJkYCzs/2026D-I?node-id=230-8758", "markReference": "https://tjdi.tongji.edu.cn/images/logo_k.png", "vectorMarkReference": "https://tjdi.tongji.edu.cn/uploadfile/file/201706/2614984424885774076.pdf", "sceneGenerationPrompt": "Produce ONE finished real-photography cinematic key-art BACKPLATE, vertical 2:3, for a design college's student-run magical sorting night. The attached reference is ONLY the event's actual graphic source: extract its flat electric cobalt surfaces, its acid-yellow open angular D-shaped wayfinding portal, its chevrons and one five-point gold sign-star, and rebuild them as three-dimensional stage scenery in a real university design workshop after hours. NO reference words, dates, letters or marks are to be copied. This is a photographed piece of stagecraft for an art-house coming-of-age film, with inky blacks, Yves-Klein ultramarine, vivid citron and rare honey-colored tungsten highlights. No humans. The hero: ONE immediately recognizable fantastical sorting HAT, an extraordinary wearable theatrical prop handmade from oversized folded ivory architectural tracing paper, with a deep dark hollow under a broad swooping turned-up brim, tall asymmetric origami crown tapering into a single jaunty sideways bent point. Large overlapping translucent ivory sheets, torn-edge fibres, pencil registration ticks and subtle seam shadows, an almost glowing edge with grazing hard side-light. It is NOT a paper boat, mountain, top hat, cone pile, cartoon, or character. Absolutely no anthropomorphic eyes, mouth, face, cute cloud mascot or Hogwarts decoration. The hat hangs impossibly a handspan above a dark metal drafting stool, its tilted brim casting a distinct separated shadow. Tight camera, hat striking and genuinely huge in the MIDDLE RIGHT, spanning horizontally x=28%-94% and vertically y=42%-73%. Its crown can reach up to y=34% only on the right. In the back, an outsized real painted neon-chartreuse faceted D-portal from the supplied event art is partly cropped on the right; angle and perspective like a physical set. The RIGHT BACK WALL between x=68%-95%, y=18%-32% is quiet dark-blue exposed concrete with enough flat space to subsequently project a school emblem. One tiny out-of-focus physical arrow station sign and a partially occluded amber five-point cutout as secondary props, with actual cast shadows. Atmosphere of a material lab turned into a stage, one controlled shaft of light through haze, tangible scale, quiet anticipation, deep foreground shadow, beautiful optical grain from scanned 35mm film, art-directed, confident. The UPPER LEFT third (x=3%-61%, y=7%-40%) has large continuous deep royal-blue negative space with subtle dark texture for large typography which will be typeset separately. Uppermost strip quiet to allow event date at top RIGHT. LOWER 18% of frame also very dark and quiet for typography. Edge-to-edge image, no border. No letters, title, numbers, text, invented shield, fake emblems, watermark, extra hats or duplicate focal objects. Graphic bold silhouettes read very clearly at phone size. Capture a precise unrepeatable in-camera moment; avoid generic CGI, glossy fantasy game poster, symmetrical centered layout, fairy sparkles and oversaturated laser effects.", "fonts": "Noto Serif SC, Noto Sans SC; glyphs converted to outlines for reliable cross-device display."}
